packageRules.description: ansible-lint, molecule and molecule-plugins are usually released together; update them in one PR.
A new Postgres major can't read the old data directory: the upgrade goes through a fresh dump (README, Paperless). Only create the PR on approval in the dependency dashboard.
Paperless supports only the Gotenberg major its upstream compose files use (tests/test_renovate.py). Raise the cap when a Paperless release does.
Paperless supports only the Tika major its upstream compose files use (Tika 4 answers in Markdown, not XHTML). Raise the cap when a Paperless release does.
Gotenberg and Tika follow Paperless: the PR says how to align them.
prBodyNotes:
**Gotenberg and Tika:** Paperless dictates their versions. Prompt for Claude:

```text
Paperless-ngx is updated to {{{newVersion}}} on branch {{{branchName}}} of private-cloud. Read the gotenberg and tika image tags in docker/compose/docker-compose.*.yml of paperless-ngx at tag v{{{newVersion}}} and its release notes since v{{{currentVersion}}}. Compare them with paperless/docker-compose.yaml. If upstream moved to a newer minor or major, push the matching tags to this branch, raise allowedVersions for gotenberg/gotenberg or apache/tika in renovate.json on a new major, and check the Gotenberg flags against the new version (homelab-security#4). Report what changed, or that nothing has to.
```
